newsitem.title: USA: UPS runs ad saying last-ditch talks failed.
newsitem.headline: UPS runs ad saying last-ditch talks failed.

text.p: The United Parcel Service ran a full page advertisement in Friday's Washington Post newspaper saying it was unable to reach an agreement with the Teamsters Union in last-minute contract negotiations.

The Teamsters and UPS continued negotiations past the midnight deadline when the union's contract officially expired. Union officials said talks were continuing but gave no information regarding a possible strike.

The advertisement said: "For nearly five years, UPS has attempted to negotiate a new contract with the International Brotherhood of Teamsters, on behalf of 190,000 employees represented by the union. Thus far, we have been unable to reach an agreement. Our contract expired on July 31."
The ad goes on to reassure customers that these negotiations would not impact the quality of UPS service.
